title: John Robichaux's instruments and his music library
summary: The uncle's violin, bass drum and arranging, and the distribution of his music books, with talk of mazurkas, cakewalks and quadrilles.

story.theme_name: Brass bands, parades and jazz funerals
story.community_name: Fiddlers and reading violinists of New Orleans

blocks.x: Do you remember much about your uncle? He played violin, I understand. Anything else?

Yeah, he played bass drum in the brass bands. He was a left-handed, is that right? Left-handed violin player, and then he was a pretty good writer too. Yes, Mr. Very nice writer. In fact, I have a lot of his books here, what my aunt gave me, and music, they wanted to give me a lot of music, but I had, at that time I had more music than I could handle myself. So finally she gave something to different people, Peter Bocard and the library and most of it, to Dave Frank.
I believe somebody said, Kid Howard may have some of it, do you know?
Yeah. I forgot to ask him. Yeah, she gave Kid Howard some. Kid Howard had quite a bit too. And Dave Frank, he had a library and he had it that...
You know, I got one set of band books that Maurice Durand had, that had the John Robichaux's little rubber stamp printed in. I have those yet on there. Yeah, he has those.

Well, he had a whole lot of those. And there were some of those numbers that I'm sorry that I didn't take at that time, because you can't find them, and a lot of people look for them because they had a lot of things that they called mazookas, dance they used to do around here, and cakewalks, and they used to use special music for that, you know. Oh yeah. And there were tunes which right now you could do a whole lot with them.
The book I got was a brass band book, had my Maryland in it, and some of those pieces, and marches, it was all marches.
Yeah. Well, those are the things that I'm trying to get a hold of.
You want to look at my book sometime, it's not much in the way of mazookas or quadrilles, nothing like that.
Yeah, quadrilles too, that's another one.
I didn't get any of that.
But I do just have a few marches, I'll show you someday.
